firstPlayerRule: Whoever was abroad most recently takes the starting-player token and starts the game.
clarifications: The second player receives 1 gold, the third 2 gold, and the fourth 3 gold.
Turns continue clockwise from the starting player.

sources.title: Anno 1800 English manual
